item.title: oMLX: Local LLM Inference Server for Apple Silicon with SSD KV Cache
item.description: oMLX brings hot-and-cold SSD KV cache tiering, continuous batching, and MCP coding agent integration to local LLM inference on Apple Silicon Macs.

item.description: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF uses weight-level abliteration and GGUF/MLX quantization to run a 27B multimodal LLM offline on Apple Silicon unified memory.

item.title: batisay: Free On-Device Korean Speech-to-Text Tuned for Apple Silicon
item.description: batisay fine-tunes Whisper large-v3-turbo on 4,300 hours of conversational Korean and runs locally on MacBooks via whisper.cpp and Apple Silicon Metal acceleration.
